# Kalaris Labs - Full Documentation Context
> Comprehensive context for LLMs and AI agents regarding Kalaris Labs architecture and infrastructure.

## Core Philosophy
Science is too important to be bottle-necked by human limits. We are building the infrastructure to transition scientific discovery from an artisanal, human-bound process to an industrial, computationally scalable one.

## Platform Architecture

### 1. Research Runtime
Orchestrates end-to-end research workflows. Decomposes high-level scientific goals into executable tasks across a graph of specialized AI agents.

### 2. Inference Engine
GPU-native inference stack utilizing TensorRT, dynamic batching, and intelligent model routing to serve 100B+ parameter models with minimal latency.

### 3. Agent Skills
Modular capabilities that agents can invoke:
- Literature Review
- Hypothesis Generation
- Peer Review
- Citation Validation
- Benchmarking
- Simulation
- Statistics
- Experiment Planning

### 4. Verification System
Automated reproducibility checking, statistical validation, and adversarial review. Every claim is checked against source material.

### 5. Multi-Agent Graph
A directed graph of agents (Planner, Researcher, Critic, Verifier, Publisher) that collaborate and converge on verified scientific output.

### 6. SEO Agents & AIO/GEO Strategies
Autonomous SEO agents running on the Kalaris orchestration runtime to continuously monitor and optimize brand visibility. These agents implement:
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Designing explicit schemas, clean Q&A definitions, and verified factual citations that Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Gemini trust and cite.
- AI Overview Optimization (AIO): Injecting concise bulleted takeaways, structured summary headers, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) patterns that Google AI Overviews easily extract.
- Automated Indexing & Crawler Loops: Dynamically syncing sitemaps, robots.txt bot rules, and llms.txt structures based on current search space performance.

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 15 (App Router)
- React 19
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Framer Motion
- GSAP / Lenis for animation and scroll
